create_job_manager: create a JobManager instance to handle a job runner compute for a specific processing step
run_job_process: run a job through the JobManager process method with validation, compute, and size checking
set_job_crashed: set a JobManager job as crashed with an error message and optional cause exception
set_job_exceeded_duration: set a JobManager job as exceeded maximum duration with an error message and optional cause
finish_job_result: finish a JobManager job by calling finish_job with the computed job result
